scope: DEMO credits only; independent Monte Carlo re-simulation, not a certification

method.seeds: serverSeed = sha256("sollish-rtp-audit-20261023/resim/<game>/<mode>"), clientSeed = "rtp-audit-20261023", seedHex = HMAC-SHA256(serverSeed, "<clientSeed>:<nonce>")[0..16], nonce 0..rounds-1 (slot-fair deriveSeedHex rule)
method.engine: SLOT_GAMES[game].play / .cost (public registry; same functions as the RGS server and the browser)
method.verdict: PASS when the claimed RTP lies inside the new 95% interval and every round cost equals the registry cost; else FAIL
method.zVsOriginal: (new - original) / sqrt(seNew^2 + seOriginal^2); Damla: (new - exact) / seNew
